answer: The nectar register is checked at draw time, anchor lists the eligible set, and quill seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 72 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 72 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. A 190 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
